sourceGapEligibility.specification_gap: A scoped source supports a requested measurement, capacity, configuration, color, material or similar specification that is absent from the actual baseline and product title and would materially help answer the question.
sourceGapEligibility.model_detail_gap: A scoped source supports a useful identity, exact part/model qualification or requested model relationship absent from the baseline and title. A question-only identifier is not factual proof; a neighboring model, shared brand or listing part number cannot establish compatibility. Preserve unresolved relationships.
sourceGapEligibility.baseline_complete_control: The baseline covers the useful facts relevant to the question available in the full sources, including at least one useful fact supported by a literal quote from an actual baseline source body.
sourceGapEligibility.ineligible_or_uncertain: Use when no useful supported gap or meaningful complete control can be established, support or applicability is ambiguous, or a supposedly new source only repeats an available fact.
sourceGapEligibility.multiplePossibleGroups: Choose the group of the primary useful missing fact requested by the question. An incidental model identifier does not turn a specification question into a model-detail gap. A case occupies only one group.
sourceGapEligibility.absenceReview: Check every supplied baseline body and the title for equivalent facts, preserving each source's original customer-question scope. Different IDs, wording or formatting alone do not establish a gap.

receives: complete source bodies with original customer-question scope
independent source-supported references and unresolved relationships
anonymous A/B answers and their citations
withheldUntilBothReviewsAreSaved: latency, token usage and planning accounting
axes: factual consistency with the scoped full source packet
support from the actual cited source bodies
blindReview.contextClaims: Do not mark a claim about which information was supplied, or an input-relative abstention, factually wrong without the withheld input context. Record missing useful facts as coverage observations; assess input-relative appropriateness after unblinding.
blindReview.referenceCorrections: Preserve source-supported corrections and disagreements. Source references are AI assessments, not human gold or independent physical verification.

postReview.attribution: Inspect whether a designated missing fact reached candidate generation and was correctly used and supported. A preference with unchanged context cannot establish a retrieval benefit. A wording preference alone is not a factual or coverage improvement.
postReview.agreement: Report reviewer agreement and disagreement without forced consensus or treating two correlated AI judgments as human truth.
postReview.inputRelativeAbstention: Separate an appropriate refusal under missing baseline context from end-to-end fact coverage. Baseline completeness is evaluated again using the actual frozen generation inputs.

metrics.literalCitationMatching: A structural check; does not establish semantic support, factual correctness or human-reviewed quality.
metrics.quality: Source-supported blind AI assessments on this targeted sample, with disagreements and limitations retained.
metrics.resources: Report measured source counts, input/output tokens and response durations. Context size differs. Local planning allowances are not settled charges or provider-enforced caps; do not infer cost or latency savings.

limitations: Selection deliberately targets baseline-source gaps; results cannot estimate natural failure prevalence or general answer-quality improvement.

The original 64-product protocol failed feasibility. This separate exploratory comparison uses the entire ordered 44-product diagnostic partial pool, before any gap judgments or generation. It is not an unseen-source holdout or completion of the original protocol.
A model identifier or listing part number does not establish compatibility or interchangeability.

Candidate rules remain unchanged from the original freeze. Supplemental misses, ties, factual regressions, failed calls and reviewer disagreements remain in the denominator. The postposed-request limitation remains accepted, not fixed.

poolProvenance.selection: First qualifying rows up to the group maxima; both gap minima and exactly two controls are required. Any final-baseline role failure aborts without replacement.

executionEligibility.deliveryRequires: A designated missing fact must have its cited source ID and literal quote in an added candidate parent with the original question scope retained; baseline absence must already have passed independent final-baseline review.
executionEligibility.zeroDeliveryAction: Stop the whole selected packet before requesting paid execution; preserve every candidate miss and selected case. Do not replace cases, tune candidate rules or infer an answer-quality result.
executionEligibility.positiveDeliveryAction: Keep every selected gap, control and miss; freeze the exact 2N answer-call plan and obtain its reviewed financial scope before dispatch.
